name: MarkIt
long_description: MarkIt is an AI-powered regulatory compliance platform that helps consumer brands launch products in new markets. We review formulations, packaging, and supporting documents against local regulations, identify compliance gaps, and provide the exact changes, regulatory references, and market-ready labels needed before launch. We are initially focused on cosmetics and food products entering the U.S., replacing weeks of manual work across regulatory consultants, spreadsheets, and disconnected vendors with one actionable compliance workflow.
one_liner: Compliance that makes products ready for global markets.
